title: The rules every Beethoven program that starts or judges Claude Code applies
description: No API key anywhere (greg, 2026-10-04 13:27Z: the only fundamental rule of this software). hpcworker applies these in framework/jobs/worker.sbatch.tpl (CLEAN_ENV), framework/bin/hpcworker (clean_env_args) and framework/lib/adapters/common.sh (hpcw_agent_env, hpcw_claude_signin); test_interface.py fails when the code and this file differ. A program that starts Claude Code removes every name in credential_variables from its environment; a program that judges `claude auth status` counts as signed in only what subscription_signin says, and is tested against signin_cases.

remote_control_variables.description: also removed where Remote Control runs: they switch off what Remote Control needs

agent_markers.description: a destructive or person-only subcommand refuses when any of these is set and not empty, or when standard input is not a terminal

subscription_signin.description: what `claude auth status` printed -> subscription, other or none; other counts as no sign-in everywhere
subscription_signin.other: loggedIn is true and apiKeySource is present (its value is not read), or authMethod is not claude.ai, or apiProvider is present and not firstParty
subscription_signin.subscription: loggedIn is true, authMethod is claude.ai, apiProvider is firstParty or absent, and apiKeySource is absent
